title: Create a landing page
blurb: Build a single-page offer or lead capture page with a funnel.

steps.title: Open Sites
steps.body: Landing pages are built as **Funnels**. Click **Sites** in the left menu.

steps.title: Choose Funnels
steps.body: Click **Funnels**. A funnel is a page, or a short series of pages, with one goal: capture a lead or make a sale.

steps.title: Pick how to start
steps.body: Choose **From templates** for a ready-made offer or lead capture page, **Build with AI** to have it drafted for you, or **From blank**. Name it after your offer, like **Free Quote**, then click **Create**.
steps.tip: Build with AI is the fastest: describe your business and offer, and it writes the first draft.

steps.title: Add your form
steps.body: Make sure the page has a **form** with the fields you need (name, email, phone). Every submission lands in **Contacts** automatically.
steps.tip: Pair it with the workflow guide so new leads get an instant reply.

steps.title: Save and share
steps.body: Click **Save**, then **Preview** to test it. Copy the page link to use in ads, emails or social posts, or connect your domain under **Domain Settings**.
